warnings: Shift Coastal Technologies: OceanSled Ranger is in a testing-stream contract; public evidence does not establish accepted performance, operational adoption or production capacity.
H2 Analytics: Public records do not disclose EASE hosting, security accreditation, named production configurations or independently measured training outcomes.
YMX Innovation Centre: The boundary between YMX facility services, NEXUS program authority and broader Quebec aerospace initiatives requires reviewer confirmation before publication.
OceanWorks International: No material dated current-development source was recovered, so the candidate intentionally leaves the Recent Activity callout unsupported and hidden.

Sapper Labs Group: BetaKit independently reports the March 2026 alliance and quotes Denvr's chief executive, but no Denvr-owned release or deployment evidence was recovered; historical DND records use Sapper Labs Cyber Solutions Inc. while the current site uses Sapper Labs Group.
Metaspectral: The Tanager integration is strongly documented by Metaspectral, but independent Planet-authored confirmation and defence-specific operational evidence remain limited.
Shark Marine Technologies: The CanadaBuys notice closed July 27, 2026 and is not proof of award, delivery, acceptance or operational use; follow-on status was not recovered.
ITRES Research: The Hexagon acquisition is confirmed by both parties, but public sources do not yet define post-acquisition Canadian production capacity or defence-specific availability.
